name: Voodoo Sovereign
theme: Apotheosis of the Curse King. Hex crits, Hex consumes detonate at 2× damage, every skill bears the curse.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Hex can crit. Skills that consume Hexed deal 2× damage.'
Pairs with witchdoctor.json voodoo_sovereign path — same id, mirrors the path-7 capstone Crowned in Curses + amplifies via this ascendancy.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~24 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Witch's Eye.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 5 of 8 nodes have working effects today (whileTag(hex) damageMult, perStack(hex) damageMult, procOnCrit applyTag(hex), incChaosDamage stat). Hex-can-crit + hex-consume-2x-damage capstone is decorative until Phase F lands modifyMechanic:hexCanCrit + onHexConsume hooks.

nodes.name: Curse Affinity
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% damage to Hexed targets (foundation curse-vulnerability scaler).

nodes.name: Voodoo Strength
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% chaos damage (foundation scaling — chaos is the Voodoo Sovereign's native channel).

nodes.name: Hex Mark
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15% chance to apply Hexed regardless of skill (cross-skill Hex applier).

nodes.name: Curse Bound
nodes.description: +2/4/6% damage per Hex stack on target (rewards stacking the curse before consuming it).

nodes.name: Bloodied Curse
nodes.description: Crits have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply 2 additional Hex stacks on hit (broader than design intent — engine cannot filter procOnCrit by target tag today, so this fires on any crit).

nodes.name: Witch's Eye
nodes.description: All your skills, regardless of weapon, apply Hexed on hit (cross-weapon Hex applier — universal Witchdoctor curse flavor).

nodes.name: Hex Reaver
nodes.description: On killing a Hexed enemy, gain a 4-second Curse Empowered stack (max 5); each stack +5/10/15% chaos damage.

nodes.name: Crowned in Curses
nodes.description: Hex can crit. Skills that consume Hexed deal 2× damage. The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
